annotations.text:
Click day 73 — the run that failed.
Pick a stage to see what it raised, and the Resume that re-runs from there rather than from the beginning.
Turn a dial. The panel shows the branch it would open — the live ruleset is never edited, so a draft that is never merged changes nothing.

Switch FEATURES_CONTINUITY off.
Nothing on any other screen changes shape — the same property the anti-leak suite asserts for players.
Every number here is from a running world: day 74, 7 open crises, and one incursion of 10 hulls raised from a severity-5 stability crisis in Region 3.
